seed_data.title: Sea buckthorn Hand Cream for Dry Hands | Natural Hand Butter | Lhamour
seed_data.description:
Sea Buckthorn Hand Butter for Dry & Cracked Hands 

Lhamour Sea Buckthorn Hand Butter is an intensive hand treatment created to nourish, protect, and restore very dry, rough, and climate-damaged hands. Inspired by Mongolia’s extreme cold and dry environment, this rich hand butter is designed to withstand harsh weather, frequent hand washing, and daily environmental stress.

Hands are often the first area to show signs of dryness and damage, especially in cold climates. This deeply nourishing formula helps lock in moisture, soften rough skin, and support the skin barrier—keeping hands comfortable, smooth, and protected.

Who Is This Hand Butter For? 

Very dry, rough, or cracked hands

Hands exposed to cold weather, wind, or dry air

Skin affected by frequent washing or sanitizing

Anyone needing long-lasting hand protection

Key Benefits 

Deeply nourishes dry and cracked hands

Helps protect the skin barrier from moisture loss

Softens rough texture and improves skin comfort

Provides long-lasting protection without frequent reapplication

Leaves hands smooth, not greasy

Powered by Sea Buckthorn 

Sea buckthorn is traditionally valued for its nourishing properties and its naturally high content of essential fatty acids. In this hand butter, it helps support skin softness and resilience—especially in dry, cold, and demanding conditions.

Texture & Feel 

This hand butter has a rich, balm-like texture that melts into the skin, forming a protective layer without feeling sticky. A small amount goes a long way, making it ideal for both day and night use.

Lhamour Coconut Lip Balm for Dry & Sensitive Lips 

Lhamour Coconut Lip Balm is a gentle, deeply nourishing lip balm created to protect and soften dry, sensitive lips. Inspired by skincare traditions shaped by Mongolia’s harsh climate, this balm helps prevent moisture loss while keeping lips comfortable, smooth, and naturally supple.

Dry air, wind, and everyday exposure can quickly dehydrate lips. Lhamour Coconut Lip Balm is formulated to provide reliable, everyday care with a simple, comforting formula that supports the lips’ natural barrier without heaviness.

Who Is This Lip Balm For? 

Dry, sensitive, or easily chapped lips

Everyday lip care in dry or cold climates

People who prefer a mild, natural scent

Anyone seeking simple, effective lip protection

Key Benefits 

Helps protect lips from dryness and moisture loss

Softens and smooths dry, chapped lips

Supports the natural lip barrier

Provides comfortable, everyday hydration

Leaves lips nourished, not sticky or greasy

Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil – deeply nourishes and softens lips

Why Choose Lhamour Lip Care? 

Lhamour lip care is inspired by Mongolia’s extreme climate, where protecting skin from dryness is essential. Our Coconut Lip Balm is crafted with carefully selected ingredients to provide simple, effective protection for everyday use.

Soothe, Repair & Protect During Breastfeeding — Naturally

This organic nipple butter for breastfeeding is designed to relieve sore, cracked, and dry nipples , while protecting delicate skin during one of the most sensitive stages of motherhood.

Made with 100% natural, baby-safe ingredients , it provides deep nourishment and relief — without the need to wipe off before feeding.

Why It Works

Relieves sore nipples: Helps reduce pain and discomfort from breastfeeding

Repairs cracked skin: Supports natural healing and restores moisture

Safe for baby: Food-grade ingredients, no need to wipe off before nursing 

Protective barrier: Shields skin from dryness and friction

Multi-use: Can be used on any dry or sensitive skin areas

The Power of Natural, Edible Ingredients

Unlike conventional nipple creams that may contain synthetic additives, this formula is made with pure, simple ingredients safe enough for baby contact 

Key Ingredients

Coconut Oil – Deep hydration and soothing relief

Olive Oil – Nourishes and supports skin repair

Beeswax – Creates a protective barrier

Tallow (Sheep’s Tail Fat) – Rich in nutrients for deep skin repair

Vitamin E – Helps protect and restore skin

These ingredients work together to heal, protect, and nourish delicate skin naturally

Natural Nipple Butter vs Lanolin

Many nipple creams use lanolin — but it’s not for everyone.

This natural nipple butter:

No synthetic additives or fragrances 

No need to wash off before breastfeeding 

Lightweight and easy to apply

Multi-purpose for dry skin

A clean, gentle alternative for mothers who prefer natural skincare 

Who It’s For

Breastfeeding mothers with sore or cracked nipples

Expecting mothers preparing for breastfeeding

Sensitive or easily irritated skin

Anyone looking for organic nipple cream safe for baby 

How to Use

Apply a small amount to nipples after each feeding. Use regularly to soothe and protect the skin.

You can also:

Use during late pregnancy to prevent dryness

Apply to other dry areas of the body

Why Lhamour

Born in Mongolia, Lhamour creates skincare designed for extreme conditions and real skin needs . Our products are made with simple, natural ingredients to deliver safe, effective results — even for the most delicate skin .

Gentle Care for You & Your Baby

Breastfeeding can be beautiful — but also challenging. This organic nipple butter is designed to make your journey more comfortable, natural, and supported.

seed_data.description:
Lhamour Baby Lotion for Sensitive & Delicate Skin 

This natural baby lotion for dry and sensitive skin is designed to deeply hydrate, soothe irritation, and support eczema-prone skin. Made with gentle, non-toxic ingredients, it protects and nourishes your baby’s delicate skin every day.

Baby skin is thinner and more sensitive than adult skin, making it more vulnerable to dryness, irritation, and environmental stress. Lhamour Baby Lotion is thoughtfully formulated to provide lightweight yet effective hydration without overwhelming the skin.

Why This Baby Lotion Works

Deep hydration for dry baby skin

Helps soothe eczema and irritation

Lightweight, fast-absorbing (no greasy feel)

Supports skin barrier development

Safe for daily use on sensitive skin 

Inspired by Mongolian Skincare

In Mongolia’s harsh climate, skin needs real protection and hydration. Lhamour brings this philosophy into baby care — creating products that strengthen and protect delicate skin naturally.

Who Is This Baby Lotion For? 

Babies and toddlers with dry or sensitive skin

Daily moisturizing after bath time

Skin exposed to dry air, cold weather, or indoor heating

Parents seeking gentle, minimal skincare for their baby

Key Benefits 

Provides gentle, long-lasting hydration

Helps support and protect the skin’s natural barrier

Keeps baby skin soft, smooth, and comfortable

Absorbs easily without stickiness or heaviness

Suitable for everyday use

Ingredients 

Aqua (Water) – provides lightweight hydration

Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil – nourishes and helps maintain moisture balance

Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea Butter) – softens and protects delicate skin

Cera Alba (Beeswax) – helps prevent moisture loss and shields skin

Tocopherol (Vitamin E) – helps condition and protect the skin

Texture & Feel 

This baby lotion has a soft, lightweight texture that spreads easily and absorbs quickly, leaving baby skin smooth and comfortable without a greasy residue.

Why It Works

Relieves sore nipples: Helps reduce pain and discomfort from breastfeeding

Repairs cracked skin: Supports natural healing and restores moisture

Safe for baby: Food-grade ingredients, no need to wipe off before nursing 

Protective barrier: Shields skin from dryness and friction

Multi-use: Can be used on any dry or sensitive skin areas

Unlike conventional nipple creams that may contain synthetic additives, this formula is made with pure, simple ingredients safe enough for baby contact 

Key Ingredients

Coconut Oil – Deep hydration and soothing relief

Olive Oil – Nourishes and supports skin repair

Beeswax – Creates a protective barrier

Tallow (Sheep’s Tail Fat) – Rich in nutrients for deep skin repair

Vitamin E – Helps protect and restore skin

These ingredients work together to heal, protect, and nourish delicate skin naturally

Many nipple creams use lanolin — but it’s not for everyone.

This natural nipple butter:

No synthetic additives or fragrances 

No need to wash off before breastfeeding 

Lightweight and easy to apply

Multi-purpose for dry skin

A clean, gentle alternative for mothers who prefer natural skincare 

Who It’s For

Breastfeeding mothers with sore or cracked nipples

Expecting mothers preparing for breastfeeding

Sensitive or easily irritated skin

Anyone looking for organic nipple cream safe for baby

Apply a small amount to nipples after each feeding. Use regularly to soothe and protect the skin.

You can also:

Use during late pregnancy to prevent dryness

Apply to other dry areas of the body

Born in Mongolia, Lhamour creates skincare designed for extreme conditions and real skin needs . Our products are made with simple, natural ingredients to deliver safe, effective results — even for the most delicate skin .

seed_data.description:
Hydrating Facial Cream for Dry & Sensitive Skin 

Lhamour Hydrating Facial Cream is a deeply nourishing daily moisturizer developed for dry, sensitive, and climate-stressed skin. Inspired by Mongolia’s extreme cold and dry environment, this cream is designed to support the skin barrier, lock in moisture, and keep skin comfortable throughout the day. 

Unlike lightweight lotions that evaporate quickly, this rich yet fast-absorbing facial cream delivers long-lasting hydration without feeling heavy or greasy. It is ideal for people whose skin feels tight, flaky, or irritated due to cold weather, wind, or low humidity. 

Who Is This Facial Cream For? 

Dry or very dry skin 

Sensitive or reactive skin 

Skin exposed to cold, wind, or dry indoor heating 

Anyone seeking a gentle, daily facial moisturizer 

Key Benefits 

Provides deep, long-lasting hydration 

Helps strengthen and protect the skin barrier 

Reduces tightness, dryness, and discomfort 

Leaves skin soft, smooth, and balanced 

Absorbs easily and works well under makeup 

Texture & Feel 

This facial cream has a rich, comforting texture that melts into the skin and absorbs smoothly without clogging pores. Skin feels nourished and protected, not oily. 

Why Choose Lhamour? 

Lhamour skincare is inspired by Mongolia’s harsh climate, where protecting the skin barrier is essential for comfort and health. Our formulas focus on simple, effective ingredients and long-lasting nourishment, making them especially suitable for dry and sensitive skin.
